title: Gemma 4 E4B Heretic Uncensored
summary: An unrestricted version of Google's Gemma 4 model, modified using the HERETIC abliteration method to neutralize safety guardrails and refusal directions. It is optimized for creative writing and roleplay without AI lecturing or filtering.
research_notes: Highly popular in the local LLM community for its 'nanny-free' behavior; requires GGUF-compatible inference tools like LM Studio or llama.cpp.

evolution.summary: The project evolved to include 'Thinking' variants like DECKARD HERETIC, which feature augmented chain-of-thought reasoning while maintaining an uncensored status. The HERETIC process itself reached version 1.2.0 by mid-2026.
